run_kinematics: run forward kinematics to compute global positions and orientations for all bodies, sites, and geoms
run_com_pos: run center of mass computation to accumulate subtree CoM and compute composite inertias and cdof
run_crb: run composite rigid body inertia accumulation up the kinematic tree and compute joint-space inertia matrix
run_rne: run recursive Newton-Euler inverse dynamics to compute bias forces and internal forces for the current state
run_solve_m: run Cholesky factorization and backsubstitution to solve the linear system x = inv(L'*D*L) * y
